subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or repair the open candidate PR for this Dashboard busy-state issue, ask the contributor for a current-main rebase plus live proof, or replace it with a narrower current-main fix?
rationale: The issue has an open closing PR, but that PR is conflicting and proof-gated while current main only shows partial source-level recovery, so choosing the ownership path requires human review rather than a new automatic fix lane.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can preserve the useful recovery intent while aligning with the current chat lifecycle and session active-run helpers.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The original contributor can update the open PR against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another review.

options.title: Close the candidate PR only
options.body: If maintainers decide the stale PR should not be repaired, keep this issue open until a new canonical fix path exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can preserve the useful recovery intent while aligning with the current chat lifecycle and session active-run helpers.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available routing candidate from recent current-main chat UI work and adjacent session-control history.
